blogPosts.excerpt: The Core Of The Design Centers On Logical Principles And Engineering Structure. children.text: Overview

The hidden hook is an integrated hardware accessory that combines structural engineering, space optimization, and high-strength manufacturing processes. The combination of "foldable concealed structures" and "high load-bearing support systems" allows this product to achieve efficient load-bearing and visual concealment in limited spaces. This product is a representative of modern hardware development in the direction of "simplification and functional integration, as well as structural reinforcement." The concealed hook does not have a single-point exposed hanger. Instead, it is a composite structure that includes a hidden base, a foldable mounting system for the wall, and a reinforced pivot structure. The hanging arm is flat and has no protrusions when in storage. It can be opened by pressing or rotating it, creating a stable point for hanging.
What Are The Core Functions?

To reduce the number of welding points and avoid structural loosening risks, high-quality products use precision die-casting or integrated CNC machining processes. This improves overall durability and safety. The tensile strength is 520-750MPa, and the yield strength is approximately 205MPa. This ensures structural stability and resists deformation when high loads are applied.
Diverse materials structures

Three grades of stainless steel are available. SUS201 is an economical choice for those who are looking for a durable, dry environment. Second-grade stainless steel is SUS304, which offers excellent resistance to rust and oxidation. SUS316 is the best choice for properties located near the ocean. It offers excellent resistance to corrosion caused by salt spray and can handle high humidity.
Optimized thickness and strength

The main body thickness is usually between 3mm and 6mm for heavy-duty models. The bending resistance of the sheet is approximately 30-50% higher than that of thinner sheets. The bearing system is housed in a thickened stainless steel core. This design is combined with a damping structure and limiter to prevent loosening after extended use.
Superior performance with optimized thickness and strength

Hidden hooks are required to withstand repeated movements of opening and closing during long-term usage. The high-quality products are tested for corrosion resistance and 10,000-30,000 cycles of opening and closing. They also undergo a 48-72-hour salt spray test. The SUS304 stainless material used in hooks has a tensile resistance of 520-750MPa and a bending deformation resistance approximately 25% greater than ordinary carbon steel.
High Load-Bearing Design

The design of high-quality concealed hooks allows them to achieve a load-bearing performance that is engineering-grade, despite their small size and high load. This is achieved through material reinforcement, structural optimization and stress distribution, which makes them ideal for environments with high frequency use, such as the kitchen.

The hidden swivel consists of typically three parts: A precision shaft structure, a stainless steel bushing or alloy bushing, and a locking and limiting structure with two sides. This structure provides a rotational lifetime of 20,000 to 50,000 opening and closure cycles. This structure resists uneven deformation of the load and provides long-term stability. In actual use, hooks can withstand static weight, as well as instantaneous suspension impact, swinging tension and high-frequency vibratory vibrations caused by picking up and putting things down. The dynamic load tolerance of hooks is increased by 45%. They are also less likely to loosen even after repeated hanging or picking.
Space Concealment Function

The hidden hook is a cantilever folding structure with a pivoting system that allows the arm to be fully seated while not in use. The folded hook has a thickness of only 10-20mm and the wall fit error is controlled to less than 1mm. The visual projection is reduced by 60%-75%. This achieves "functional concealment", where the structure becomes visible only when it's in use.

Visual cleanliness has a direct impact on the perception of space in spatial design. When the number of wall components exposed is reduced by 30% or more, it can result in a perceived increase of 15%-20% of the space's spaciousness. The traditional hooks produce multiple visual protrusions, while the hidden hook only shows a simple metal sheet when folded. This maintains wall continuity.

Folding the concealed hook reduces its protruding height by over 70%, thereby reducing the safety risk. In kitchens and hallways, the protruding hooks can easily cause bumps, scratches to clothing and injury to children. Hidden hardware can reduce collisions between objects by up to 50%.

Exposed hardware in confined areas, such as narrow kitchen aisles of 900-1100mm, can give a sense of oppression. When folded, the design of hidden hooks reduces space for pedestrians by 40-60mm. This improves pedestrian comfort.
Conclusion

As an integral part of modern hardware, concealed hardware hooks achieve a high level of integration with structural design, material durability, and aesthetics. The "concealed structure design", "high load-bearing system", "corrosion resistant material selection" and "multiple scenario application capabilities" of these hooks make them more than just simple hooks. They are also functional extension components and space optimization tools. Functional integration and structural concealment are going to continue to be the core direction for furniture hardware components in the future. Hidden hooks, with their high-performance and professional structural design, will continue to play an important role in residential and commercial projects.

blogPosts.excerpt: The Discussion Spans A Range Of Aspects From Opening And Closing Mechanisms, Anti-Slip Safety, Structural Load-Bearing Capacity, And Spatial Aesthetics, Extending Further To Material Craftsmanship And Ergonomic Design. At A Time When Safety Serves As The Fundamental Standard And Comfort Emerges As An Implicit Expectation, This Approach Represents, Above All, A Thoughtful Response To The Subtle Details Of Daily Life.

children.text: What are high-quality bathroom hardware handles?

Bathroom hardware handles provide structural support, functional guidance and aesthetics. These handles are usually installed directly on tempered glass and act as the interface that is most frequently used between the user and glass door. The quality and design of these products determine the safety and user experience for the entire bathroom system.

Bathroom handles are an essential part of modern bathroom designs for both residential and commercial bathrooms. They not only serve the function of opening and closing the door, but they also contribute to safety, comfort and aesthetics. These handles are slowly becoming a standard configuration for shower enclosures with high-end glass, as well as glass partition doors and frameless door systems.
Systematic functions of the product
Operation of Opening and Closing

A bathroom handle's most important and basic function is to give users a stable and clear point of operation. By rationally setting up the height, position and length of the bathroom handle, users are able to quickly locate the point of maximum force when opening and closing the glass doors, improving smoothness and controllability.
Safety and Anti-slip

Hands can easily get wet in bathroom environments or even covered with soap. Bathroom handles must have excellent anti-slip properties. Surface textures, such as brushed surfaces, can increase friction coefficients. Grooved or microtextured designs also enhance grip stability. The grip diameter can be adjusted to fit the hand. This design reduces the chance of falling or pulling the glass because of unstable forces.
Stability and Load-bearing

Bathroom handles must be able to withstand constant pulling, pushing and impact forces, particularly in areas of high use or public use. Structural stability is essential. The handles are designed to distribute the force evenly when opening a glass door. This reduces the stress on the hinges and edges of the door and improves the structural stability.
Decorative Integrity

Bathroom handles serve both a practical and decorative function. Visually, handles can highlight the three-dimensional layers of the glass doors, accentuating modern, minimalist or high-end styles. They become a functional decorative feature in the bathroom. Modern high-end hardware is characterized by a design that prioritizes function and aesthetics.
Combination Of Material And Design

Most high-end bathroom hardware is made using precision die-casting of SUS304 stainless. The result is a stable structure with a dense structure that resists corrosion caused by moisture, cleaning agents and humid environments. The tensile resistance can reach >=520MPa to ensure long-term stability. The handgrip is designed ergonomically with a diameter of O25mm or O32mm and a length between 150mm, 200mm, 300mm and 400mm. Even distribution of force when gripping conforms with the comfortable grip zone. This prevents fatigue during extended use.
Summary

Bathroom handles are small, but they play a big role in the bathroom. They provide safety, functionality and aesthetics. The best bathroom handles are a combination of materials science and structural engineering, surface technologies, and user experience. As modern bathroom systems move towards customized and high-end solutions, bathroom grab bars that are durable and compatible with the system are becoming more and more "standard" in high-quality projects.

blogPosts.title: Door Handle Defines The Quality And Performance Of The Entrance
blogPosts.excerpt: Encompassing Structural Design, Color Finishes, Dimensions, And More, Are Provided To Ensure Seamless Integration With The Surrounding Environment. These Features Play A Pivotal Role In The Core Functionalities Of Heavy-Duty Door Systems, Including Opening Control, Structural Load-Bearing Capacity, Stability Under High-Frequency Usage, And Force Distribution. This Analysis Highlights The Critical Importance Of These Elements Within Modern Architectural Entryways And Explains Why High-End Projects Consistently Opt For Stainless Steel Solutions.

children.text: The main entrance door is an important part of modern architecture. It not only provides the entry and exit function, but it also defines the image and quality of a building. The quality, design, and structure of the handle, one of the most commonly used and stressed hardware components on a door directly impacts the longevity, safety performance and visual impact of the whole door. The design has become increasingly popular for villas, luxury residences, hotels and commercial buildings.
Why Use This Type Of Door Handle?

Hardware door handles are operating hardware components that are designed to be strong and durable for main entrance doors. These handles are installed on luxury double doors, villa entrance doors and high-end residential entrance doors. They are not only used to open and close the door, but also for structural stability and visual expression. Compared to interior door handles of the same size, large door handles have a more engineering-grade design, focusing on material strength, installation security, and durability over time. Heavy-duty doors cannot be without them.
What Are The Core Functions?
Controls For Opening And Closing

The weight of a door in a villa or commercial building can range from 60 to 120 kg, while some composite metal and wood doors may even weigh more than 150 kg. Large interior door handles can reduce the amount of force needed to open a door by up to 50% compared with standard handles. Under normal installation conditions, they are able to withstand pulling forces >=120kg instantaneously without structural deformation. This meets the requirements for heavy-duty doors.
Stability For High-Frequency Use

The average daily use in hotels, commercial buildings or high-end apartments can be 200-500 times. They usually pass >=100,000. Opening and closing fatigue tests. There is no sign of significant loosening or peeling. The design and standards of the handles meet the requirements of long-term, repeated use. They do not loosen or deform and maintain a stable feel.
Distributed Force Support

Door damage is often caused by the accumulation of stress over time. Multi-point structure designs distribute external forces over the entire door structure. Larger pipe diameters, thicker walls and longer handle lengths all reduce the risk for bending. This structure reduces the stress concentration in the door panel between 30% and 45%. It extends the service life of both the hinge system and the door.
Visual Entrance Guidance

The door handle has many functions, but it also serves as a visual guide for the entrance of the building. Through its straight lines, the stainless steel handle helps users quickly identify where an entrance is located, thereby improving access and visibility. This is particularly important for large buildings at night or in dark environments.
Are Stainless Steel Door Handles Preferred In High-End Buildings?

Commercial buildings use stainless steel door handles. The stainless steel door handles are extremely durable, corrosion-resistant and impact-resistant. They have a lifespan of more than 10 years. They are stable and prevent safety hazards that can be caused by loose handles. The simple lines of these handles enhance the first impression at the entrance to the building. They are very professional in their customization service. You can customize length, diameter surface color and mounting hole spacing.
Summary

The quality of a stainless steel door handle is not only evident at the time of installation, but it also remains stable, safe, and attractive after many years of use. The stainless steel door handle is one of the most reliable hardware components for a building's entry system. It also reflects professionalism and high-quality standards.

children.text: Product Overview

Hardware sliding glass door kits are an essential hardware system for modern architecture and interior designs. They're widely used to create high-end bathroom and shower partitions in hotels, residential bathrooms and commercial spaces. It achieves smooth sliding and safe load-bearing of glass doors through a high-strength rail system and precise roller structure. The sliding door kit is a key component in the glass system because it not only guides and bears the glass but also affects user experience, aesthetics and safety.
Structural Components
Rollers
Wear-resistant nylon wheel core or metal, high-strength connecting bolts. Double ball bearings ensure low friction even when loaded, reducing the resistance due to the weight of the door.
Track System

Tracks are usually made of stainless steel tubes or rails with a wall thickness between 1.5 and 2.0mm. This prevents bending due to prolonged load-bearing. The track surface has been treated with a process that not only improves aesthetics, but also reduces wear when rollers are used.
Limiters
Limiters can be used to prevent the glass doors from colliding because of inertia. They are often equipped with elastic structures or cushioning pads to reduce stress.
Anti-derailment Device

The anti-derailment mechanism is located at the bottom or under the track of the sliding glass door. The anti-derailment device prevents the glass door from falling off the track even if it is hit by an unexpected force. It is essential for the safety of sliding doors.
Main Functions

Through its precision bearing structure, the sliding door set ensures smooth and quiet operation. The coordinated working of the rollers and tracks along with the fixing parts, ensures that the sliding door set can support single or multiple tempered glass doors. High-quality sliding door kits are able to support tempered glass doors with a weight between 60kg and 100kg.
Main Functions

Through its precision bearing structure, the sliding door set ensures smooth and quiet operation. The coordinated working of the rollers and tracks along with the fixing parts ensures that the sliding door set can support single or multiple tempered glass doors. High-quality sliding door kits are able to support tempered glass doors with a weight between 60kg and 100kg.
Advantages
The bathroom or interior space will appear cleaner, more modern, and transparent.
It is ideal for small bathrooms as it doesn't take up any space.
Long-lasting service life enables long-term use and reduces future replacement and maintenance costs.
High safety: effectively prevents glass shaking or derailment. This improves daily use safety.
Engineering Projects

Glass sliding door sets are ideal for engineering projects, luxury residential projects or hotel projects. They offer high levels of standardization, product consistency and flexibility in customization. Standardized hole positions and structural designs facilitate construction on-site and reduce the installation cycle. The uniformity of dimensions and the stability of quality in each set make it perfect for large-scale purchases. Customization options include surface color, track design, roller length, logo and packaging.
Summary and Improvement

Hardware for sliding glass doors has evolved over the years from being a purely functional product to one that is a systematic product that integrates structural performance, aesthetics and reliability. It is a must-have for modern bathrooms, commercial spaces and high-end homes. As interior design and architecture continue to strive for simplicity and quality, high-end sliding glass doors will be preferred in the future.

children.text: What Are Hardware Glass Hinges?

Hardware glass fixing clips are also called glass hinges. They are hardware connectors that have been designed specifically for frameless and minimally framed systems of glass doors. These products are used to support, connect, and rotate glass door panels with walls, metal columns, or glass. They are widely used in commercial glass doors, hotel rooms, high-end residential spaces and hotels. Their high load-bearing capacities, stable pivot structure and excellent corrosion resistance have made them indispensable hardware accessories for modern glass door systems.
Main Functions
Support and Load-bearing

Glass hinges are used to secure the glass door against the wall, or fixed glass using clamping or drilling techniques. They effectively support the weight of the door. A high-quality stainless steel single hinge can support tempered glass doors up to 8-12mm thick.
Opening and Closing
The internal precision pivot ensures smooth, unobstructed opening of the glass doors, reducing stress on the edges of the glass and the hardware. This extends the life of the whole door system.
Angle control and Positioning

Some glass hinges are equipped with 90°/135°/180° position functions. This allows for automatic opening or return angles. It improves safety and space usage, and is especially useful for shower enclosures.
Product Specifications

Mainstream hinges for glass are made from SUS304 and SUS316 stainless steel, which is resistant to rust, corrosion, and high humidity. Material is strong, does not deform easily, and offers long-term stability and reliability. Surfaces can be buffed, polished or electroplated. Rubber gaskets and nylon protective pads can be used to clamp glass. This avoids direct metal-to-glass contact, which prevents glass chips and stress cracks.
Quality and Craftsmanship

In order to reduce installation errors, high-end glass hinges are often made using precision casting and CNC machining. High-quality stainless steel hinges can last up to 8-15 years under normal conditions and with proper installation.
Assembly Effects

The use of high-quality hinges for glass doors can have a significant impact on the overall look and feel of your glass door system. The frameless design creates a sense of space, highlights the sleek lines of the hardware, and integrates seamlessly with modern architectural styles. Doors open and close quietly and comfortably, resulting in a pleasant user experience. The hinges are stable even after long-term usage, which shows their structural integrity. This is a very important product that shows attention to detail and quality of engineering.
Selection Guidelines

When selecting glass hinges for actual projects, consider factors like glass thickness, door weight, operating environment, functional needs, and design style. Selecting a manufacturer who offers customized dimensions, custom surface finishes, OEM services, and other customizations will ensure the compatibility and consistency of your system.
Summary

Glass hinges, with their structural safety, spatial aesthetics, and long-term stability are no longer just auxiliary hardware for modern architecture and interior design. They are now a key component that determines how well a glass door system performs. With their durable materials and precision manufacturing, high-quality stainless steel hinges provide reliable and safe solutions for a variety of glass door applications.

children.text: How Description

Bathroom glass clamps can be used to support and fix glass shower doors, or even glass partitions. This product is used widely in frameless and semi-frameless systems. It provides a stable structure with an aesthetically pleasing look, as well as a safe use by precisely clamping tempered glass. This product is ideal for high-end public restrooms, residential bathrooms, hotel changing rooms, commercial gyms and shower rooms. Shower room designs are becoming more popular, which means that glass hardware is in demand. This includes higher standards for load-bearing capacities, corrosion resistance, structural precision and appearance. These high standards are met by stainless steel bathroom clamps that combine functionality, safety and aesthetics.
Core Functions
Stability

The bathroom glass clamp secures the glass door, fixed glass panel, or any other glass surface to the wall, the floor, or another glass surface through a mechanical clamping mechanism, effectively preventing shake, displacement, and loosening while in use.
Maximum Load Bearing Capacity

Its main structure is made of thick-walled stainless-steel and can handle significant glass weight. It also distributes the dynamic load generated by the glass during opening. Heavy-duty clamps for thicker or larger glass doors can improve the overall safety factor and ensure the shower door is stable under high-frequency, long-term use.
Connectivity
Glass clamps can be used to control the angle of installation and the position of the glass. This improves the alignment of the structure and its professionalism.
What About Features

Bathroom glass clamps tend to be made from SUS304 or SUS316. The material is corrosion-resistant, which makes it ideal for humid bathroom environments. It also has good oxidation resistance to prevent rust over time.

Surface treatments that are commonly used include mirror polishing and sanding. Surface treatment techniques that are repeated not only improve the product's appearance, but also its wear resistance and resistance to salt spray. This increases the lifespan of the entire product.
A single clamp can hold a load of 20-45 kg, which is suitable for most common glass thicknesses like 8mm/10mm/12mm.
Value and Advantages

The bathroom glass clamp has a compact, sleek design that minimizes the appearance of metal parts while maintaining the transparency of a glass partition. The design meets the requirements of modern bathroom styles, such as minimalist, light luxurious, and industrial. The glass clamp's anti-slip pads and reasonable clamping area effectively distribute the force to the glass. This reduces safety hazards that may be caused by external impacts or vibrations. This clamp is ideal for home bathrooms or public showers.

The stainless steel is corrosion and stain-resistant, and requires only a simple cleaning procedure to keep it in good condition. This makes it ideal for environments with frequent door openings and closings.

children.text: Glass clips are specialized products that use a clamping mechanism to install glass panels securely. Glass fixing clips use linear or point-based fixing methods to minimize interference with the glass's visual appearance. The glass can then present a more pure, transparent spatial effect. This method of fixing is ideal for frameless railing systems, glass partitions, and modern minimalist architecture. It combines functionality with design aesthetics.
Evolution in Demand

Glass materials are increasingly used in building construction as modern architectural concepts shift from "closed structures" to "open transparent and minimalistic" designs. Large-area glass structures are becoming a popular trend, whether they're used for residential balcony railings or commercial space partitions. They can also be used to protect public buildings from safety hazards. Hardware connectors are put to greater demands, as they must be able to support a load without compromising the visual effect, while also ensuring safety. Standardized installation methods and efficient, precise and accurate techniques are required.
In this context, the guardrail glass clips gradually replace traditional frame structures and become the main fixing solution for modern glass railings and partition systems.
Core Function System
High Stability

Glass clips reduce the risk of stress concentration by clamping the edges of the glass in multiple points. Glass clips can be used in standard engineering applications to meet horizontal load requirements >=1.0kN/m. They are also able to resist daily impacts, crowd pressure, wind loads and other external forces.
Safety

The safety contour design is essential. Glass clips are designed with a rounded safety contour. It reduces the chance of a sharp corner collision, improves safety in crowded places and meets public building safety regulations.
Materials and Processes

SUS304/SUS316 stainless materials are used in most mainstream glass clips. They are suitable for outdoor use and highly corrosive conditions, and have good structural strength and precision. SUS316 is 30%-40% more corrosion resistant than SUS304 in coastal environments or high temperature environments.

Glass clips are produced using a die-casting factory process. This results in a one-piece construction that is controlled within ±0.1mm of tolerance. This process ensures a flat surface, reduces secondary processing and increases structural reliability.

The body of the glass clip's metal thickness also affects overall performance. The metal thickness of the body is usually 4-8mm. This ensures that it will not deform or loosen easily under long-term stresses.

children.text: Overview

Hardware glass fence spigots, also called glass railing bases or glass vertical fixing brackets, are a key component of glass railing systems. This hardware is used for swimming pool fences and balcony railings. It can also be found in stair handrails or terrace guardrails. It is typically made from stainless steel and clamps tempered glasses using the bottom-fixing method. This creates a modern look without needing posts.
Structural Principle

The glass fence spigot is made up of three main components: a stainless steel base that has been thickened, an internal clamping system, and a gasket to protect the glass. Bottom fixing eliminates traditional posts and beams. The glass railing is transparent, minimalistic, and modern, enhancing the aesthetics of the entire space. The weight of the glass, as well as external forces, is transferred to the foundation by the connection of the stainless steel base with the high-strength base. This ensures structural stability over time.
Manufacturing Process

To ensure structural consistency and dimensional accuracy, the product is primarily manufactured using CNC precision machining. The critical load-bearing components are thickened in order to increase load capacity. Surface treatment processes like mirror polishing and brushing improve the product's corrosion resistance, wear resistance, and modern appearance.
Practical Performance

The glass fence spigot is designed to support the weight of the glass, but it must also withstand the lateral forces from people leaning against it, wind pressure, and everyday use. Its heavy-duty structural design allows it to support tempered glasses of different thicknesses, including 8mm, 12mm and 10mm.

The glass fence spigot is a reliable hardware solution for high-end swimming pool railing systems. It can resist moisture, chlorides and temperature fluctuations over time, without experiencing any corrosion or structural loosening. Its stable and reliable performance makes it an ideal hardware solution for high-end swimming pool railings.

children.text: Welcome to my kitchen! I’m excited to dive in and do a full on, in-depth kitchen tour today.

I will walk you through everything from the custom woodworking, my favorite appliances, my coffee and matcha corner, and speak more on the decor and choices we made to bring the space to life. I'll be sure to link* as much as I can below!
(*may contain affiliate links)
Be sure to watch the full video to catch all of the deets!
Island
First we'll start with the island. I really love our island. It fits four people comfortably and we customized it to warm up the space.
Custom Woodworking:

When we first moved into the house, the island was white drywall. We knew that we wanted to add wood to help add some depth to the kitchen and ground the space a little bit more. We ended up finding a woodworker here in Austin and we installed white oak panels, and it ended up turning out so beautiful! It really brought the space to life and helped us add more personality.
Barstools:

Our bar stools are from Article. I really love these stools and highly recommend them. They're extremely light, which is not a good or bad thing. It just always surprises people how light it is when they pull it out!
Pendant Lights:

Our lights are from Rejuvenation. I was not sure if I wanted to do black. For me, black accents weren’t something I was used to, because I like to do a lot of white and gold to keep things light and bright. However, we designed our kitchen around a Korean cabinet (we’ll get to that later!) that was passed down from my grandmother to my mom to me. I wanted to design the whole kitchen around it, because it's a very special piece, and the black pendant lights tie in super well with it.
Faucet:
Our faucet is from Rejuvenation just like our hardware. Since I really wanted the golds to match, it worked out to get the faucet and the hardware from the same brand.

P.S. I received our Rejuvenation pieces for a multi-series partnership I did with them last year — I am so grateful to have been able to partner with one of my all-time favorite home decor brands to create our dream kitchen!
Fridge
Fridge:
We invested in a built-in fridge, and I’m really glad we did. For a built-in fridge, you have to order a panel-ready fridge. The brand that we purchased is
Fisher and Paykel

The process ended up being pretty smooth — luckily, the woodworker that we hired for the island had just previously installed doors for the same fridge at another house. So, it felt like the stars were aligning. He built it and put on all of our hardware from Rejuvenation. It looks really beautiful and it functions like a normal fridge. It’s very minimal. I definitely recommend it if you have space in your budget and timeline!
Fridge Hardware:

Our fridge handles are 18”, aged brass pulls from Rejuvenation. It’s the same style as the other hardware in our house, so it flows seamlessly. However, one big con is that they do scuff up easily if you’re wearing rings (
see here
)! There are some dings and scratches now, and I wish I had realized it sooner.
Cabinet Hardware:
Everything is from the Meadows collection — these are the
knobs
, these are the
pulls
. For the pulls, we did a mix of 6” & 8”, and our large drawers were 12”.
Matcha & Coffee Corner (my fav, of course)

Let’s move on to my matcha and coffee corner. You've probably seen this area before as I film a lot here. This is my favorite spot in the whole house, because this is where I do a lot of thinking. I'll be here making my matcha latte, and I’ll set my intention for the day. It's a ritual for me to be able to slow down, make my drink, and sip it slooowly. That is what this corner means to me.
I also just wanted to note that I am the only caffeine drinker in the house! Andrew doesn't drink coffee. He has pure, un-caffeinated energy. Love that for him… but, me on the other hand… :)
Matcha Goodies
My
matcha whisk
and
matcha whisk stand
are from our sister shop,
The Homebodies
Kettle:
This kettle has been wonderful. I've had it for many years. I love how minimal it is, and I can heat to precisely the temps I need for my matcha and my pour over coffee. Kettles are clutch.
Coffee Grinder
Espresso Machine
Nutr Machine
Coffee Maker:

I love this coffee maker for when I am making more than one cup of coffee — although, there are many days I use it just for me! When choosing a coffee machine, I wanted to make sure as many of the components were stainless steel or glass, because I don’t like when hot water touches plastic. This one is the best one I could find that met my criteria, and so far, I’m really happy with it.
Favorite Appliances
Beast Blender
: I love how sleek and quiet this blender is! It takes up way less space than my Vitamix, and it’s not as noisy! It’s quickly become a staple.
Aarke Carbonator

: We drink a lot of sparkling water, and we love to make fun drinks when friends come over so our soda stream has been clutch for that. It’s also so nice that it doesn’t have a chord, and it stores so easily inside a cabinet.
Vitamix Immersion Blender
My immersion blender is such a game-changer! I use it all the time, and often question why I didn’t buy this sooner?! I really don't know. It’s been amazing. It's my favorite appliance right now.
Pantry

For anyone who wants to find a way to reorganize or invite more organization into their pantry, the answer is usually bins and containers. When you're able to group the like-minded things together, it just helps clear up the space, and it also helps you see what you already have. It helps me cut back on food waste and making sure I know what’s inside our pantry.
Glass Containers
Glasslock Containers
Kitchenware
Rug:
I looove our jute rug — it’s held up super well amongst foot traffic!
Flatware
Our gold flatware is from Year & Day, and we've had it for about four years. It's held up very well. If you're looking for gold flatware, I definitely recommend Year & Day!
Year & Day Dishes
Fable Dishes
Stasher Bags:
The best way to store snacks and bring food on-the-go.
Drawer Dividers:
There are many options depending on the size of your drawers on Amazon, at the Container Store, and other places.
Pots & Pans:

My pots and pans are from Caraway.  I know that there's a lot of stuff on the internet about them being horrible — they're not the best pans in the world, but they're definitely not the worst. I will keep using them until I can't use them anymore and then eventually switch to stainless steel. I think I just don't know how to properly cook with stainless steel yet. So, that would be my next investment if I were to buy pans again.
Dining Area

Last but not least, let’s talk dining area. A couple years ago I would never have picked black chairs, but one of the words that kept coming up when I was searching our aesthetic and interior design inspiration was Japandi. I kept searching Japanese and Scandinavian minimalism interior design, and I really love and connect with this vibe. It feels calming and intentional, yet mixed with beautiful grounding textures.
Dining Table:

I found this 86” table at the West Elm outlet. The color is called Cerused White. At the time they had discontinued it, but as of today (March 2023) it’s back. It came unfinished, so we ended up sealing it ourselves. When we sealed the table, it did make it a little bit more yellow and it brought out a lot more of the depth of the wood, but I love how it turned out. I think it looks really great in the space and we were able to fit 10 people at this table during our family reunion. We also got the bench that matched the table at the outlet.
Chairs:
honestly, my favorite chairs I’ve ever owned and even more beautiful IRL.
Korean Cabinet:
As

I mentioned before, this cabinet is the centerpiece of our kitchen. It was the inspiration behind the black accents that we went with. It was my grandmother's, and she passed it down to my mom, and she passed it down to me — three generations of women — and hopefully I can pass it down to my future child. It looks beautiful here and feels very special. I'm not accessing all parts of it as it is old and I want to preserve it, but we do keep our placemats and our coasters on it, so it does serve a function.
Decor Thoughts

I am planning to do a full home tour, but a theme that you'll notice is that I don't do a lot of decor for the sake of decor. I like the pieces to have a function or a purpose. It's how I cut back on clutter and just reduce the amount of stuff that's in the house.

However, we do have a lot of plants. It's how I like to add life and pops of color when it comes to designing the space. I really like to feel like my home is a sanctuary and I want to feel calm in my space. I had so much fun designing this house! It’s a big compliment to me when people ask who our interior designer is, because it's meee. Haha!
Thank you all so much for hanging out with me and touring my kitchen… That’s a wrap for now!

blogPosts.excerpt: A Premium Glass Railing Connector Designed Specifically For Modern Architectural Spaces. Combining Functional Versatility With A Contemporary Aesthetic, It Ensures Flexible Installation And Reliable Performance, While High-Precision Craftsmanship Guarantees Exceptional Quality And Attention To Detail.

children.text: Product Overview

Glass railings in modern architecture are more than just safety barriers. They also express aesthetics. They create a modern and open feel in interior and exterior areas with their transparent and simple design. As key components of the system, glass connected fittings have important fixing and support functions. With their multi-functional design and excellent materials, high-quality glass connected fittings have become the most popular choice on the market.
Multi-Functionality
Adjustable Angle Design

This glass connected fitting has an adjustable angle function, unlike traditional fixed connectors. The angle can be adjusted according to the architectural requirements. This design is especially suitable for complex buildings, as it solves installation problems caused by different spaces or angles.
Unique Waterproof Design

The design of glass connected fittings must include waterproofing. Waterproof performance is crucial for outdoor or humid environments. This connector uses a waterproof seal to prevent moisture from entering the connection point. It also helps to avoid corrosion and damage between the connector and the glass.
Surface Treatment and Precision Manufacturing

The appearance and dimensions of every connector are up to international standards, thanks to high-precision CNC technology and surface treatment. The connector's surface is flawlessly smooth and polished, which ensures a smooth contact between the glass and the connector and reduces wear and scratches. They can be customized to suit different decoration styles, whether matte, glossy or another surface effect.
Aesthetics & Modernity

Glass railings create a transparent and open visual effect in modern architectural design. These high-quality stainless steel connectors improve the aesthetics and stability of the railing by enhancing its safety. Transparent glass combined with elegant metal connectors creates a clean and simple design, perfect for modern homes, public buildings, and commercial spaces.
Lower Maintenance Costs

Glass connected fittings require almost no maintenance compared to metal railings. This is due to stainless steel's excellent weather and corrosion resistance. It will not rust, fade or corrode like iron or aluminum railings. Buildings that use these glass connectors can preserve their beauty and reduce maintenance costs.
